argv:
A Meridian-3 has stopped reporting. How long can it keep working
offline, and how would I detect that from the Fleet Control API?

parsed.answer:
A Meridian-3 can keep working offline for up to **12 minutes** — this is its offline autonomy window, fixed in firmware and not configurable [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy]. At the end of that window (or when its buffered task queue is exhausted, whichever comes first), it performs a safe-park: it finishes its current motion segment, moves to the nearest designated safe-park zone, sets its beacon to amber, and holds position [sample_corpus/product-specs.md:Acme Robotics — Product Specifications > Meridian-3 Autonomous Mobile Robot > Offline Autonomy].

From the Fleet Control API, here is how to detect and track this:

1. **`robot.link_lost` webhook fires** and `link_state` flips to `offline` [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?].
2. **Poll `GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry`** and watch `offline_seconds` climb. `link_state = offline` means no report has been received for more than 30 seconds, and `offline_seconds` counts from the last successful report [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry].
3. **Once `offline_seconds` crosses 12 minutes (720 seconds)**, assume the robot has safe-parked — the robot makes that decision on board, so Fleet Control cannot confirm it while the robot is offline [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Fleet Telemetry > GET /robots/{robot_id}/telemetry] [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?].
4. **On reconnect**, you will receive a `robot.link_restored` event, and if it did park, a `robot.safe_parked` event and an amber `beacon` [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?]. If the beacon stays amber for more than a minute after the link returns, that robot needs a physical check [sample_corpus/support-runbook.md:Support Runbook > Many Robots Offline at Once].

No manual intervention is required for resumption — a safe-parked robot resumes on its own once the link is restored and Fleet Control acknowledges it [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > Fleet Operations > What happens during a network outage?].
